title: ticketctl shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the CLI, hook, audit and log schemas. config.json embeds its own copies.

ts.description: UTC ISO 8601 with Z, to the second.

attempt_id.description: Shared by the records of one command.

numeric_id.description: Transition, sprint, board and attachment ids.

incomplete.description: Parts cut off or unavailable: links, comments, attachments, links.unreadable, <part>.truncated, <part>.invalid_id, fields.<name>, and for the changelog: changelog, changelog.invalid_id, changelog.truncated.

direction.description: Relative to this ticket: inward means this ticket is the target of the link type's inward phrase (for Blocks, is blocked by); outward means it is the source.

account.description: assign: me, none or an account id.

link_type.description: add_link and remove_link: the link type's name.

direction.description: add_link and remove_link: relative to the ticket, as in the ticket object's links.

other.description: add_link and remove_link: the ticket at the other end.

link_id.description: remove_link: the provider's id of the link.

step.description: One provider call in plain terms; only the properties that apply to the kind are present.

from.description: Current value (any JSON); rich text in full.

to.description: New value (any JSON); rich text in full.

oneOf.description: Provider id or key of the object a dedupe lookup found.

plan.description: The plan of a write; key is null for create. plan_sha256 covers the canonical JSON of v, action, site, key, intent and only the facts the plan reads (see Plan object). An empty steps array is the plan of an unchanged run.

changed.description: true when a provider write landed: result ok, and partial inside its envelope; false for unchanged.

attachment_id.description: attachment-add only: the id of the attachment that was uploaded, or, for an unchanged result, the identical one that already exists. Absent for every other command.

result.description: The outcome of a write. On exit 0 result is ok or unchanged; partial appears only inside details.result of an exit 12 envelope with code partial. A step code is the error code of a failed step. key and url are null only when a create landed and the provider's answer held no valid key. A no-op carries steps [], the existing comment_id (already_posted) or the existing key (reused). Nothing is rolled back. attachment_id is present only for attachment-add.

error_body.description: reason is required for exits 2 (usage, invalid_config), 20 (equal to the code) and 22 (invalid_request); null otherwise, except locked (unavailable), audit_failed and hooks_unavailable (internal).

candidates.description: Candidate names; for an unknown issue type on create, the valid types.

field_errors.description: The provider's field errors, keyed by field.

errors.description: get with several keys, none readable: the per-key errors, the same shape as get.json.

error_details.description: The structured part of an error; which keys appear depends on the code.

description.description: Untrusted Markdown rendered from the provider's rich text.

description_adf.description: Only with --include-adf. A sanitized copy of the provider's document; null when the ticket has no description.

fields.description: The configured extra fields, converted by schema; keys are the configured extra names.

ticket.description: The ticket object. get and search print it; only the requested --fields (and key and site) are present, so every other property is optional.

changelog_value.description: One side of a changed field: null (no value), text, a list of labels, an account (assignee, reporter) or a list of sprints. The kind follows the field, never the content.

field.description: The logical or extra field name when the site maps the field, else the provider's display name; never a custom field id.

audit_action.description: An audit record's action: a write action, or bulk for the batch record of sprint add-many and sprint remove-many.

audit_step_kind.description: An audit record's step kind: a plan step kind, or bulk for the batch record.

bulk_action.description: The actions a batch can run.

changing.description: The tickets whose plan has steps.

tickets.description: Each ticket's own plan object, in the order given; one with empty steps is unchanged.

bulk_plan.description: The combined plan of sprint add-many and sprint remove-many. plan_sha256 is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of {v: 1, bulk: true, action, site, tickets: [{key, plan_sha256}]}.

complete.description: true when no ticket is failed, outcome_unknown or not_run; the only case of exit 0.

changed.description: true when any ticket's provider write landed.

bulk_result.description: The outcome of sprint add-many and sprint remove-many: exit 0 only when complete. Otherwise it is printed in details.result of an exit 12 envelope. status ok: a write landed; unchanged: nothing was sent; failed: a definite error (error); outcome_unknown: the write may have landed and is never resent; not_run: stopped by an earlier failure. result is the single-ticket result object for ok and unchanged.
